title: Salary spread per department
statementMd:
For each department with employees show the gap between its highest and lowest salary.

Expected columns: `name`, `spread`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT d.name, MAX(e.salary) - MIN(e.salary) AS spread FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id GROUP BY d.id, d.name;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
